title: Computer use
description: Allow this AI session to operate the real, signed-in desktop on the session host. Select one window; activity and checkpoint screenshots appear in chat.
scope: Only the selected window is authorized. One session can control the desktop at a time; pause or stop to release it.
occupied: Another session is using this desktop. Pause or stop that session first.
windowsOnly: The first release supports signed-in Windows x64 desktops
unavailable: Cannot read status. Check the host connection and daemon version.
waitForTurn: Stop the current reply before enabling computer use.
completed: Request returned; verify the result in the app
